coordinator_decision.rationale: Coordinator accepts the bounded source contract and preserved variations in the attached source adjudication; provider disagreement is retained. No whole-function equivalence or human validation claimed.

verdict.label: separate
verdict.why: NEW is a thin lazy-loading adapter. It imports the pane module on first register, memoizes the promise, and forwards each provider call to the loaded pane with caller.window. EXISTING is the pane implementation itself, covering registration, entry lifecycle, tabs, and command execution. The only overlap is that NEW calls EXISTING's API (createBrowserPane, register, dispose), which is delegation rather than duplicated logic. I found no repeated executable policy that a shared helper could own.

provider_context_limit: Claude canonical shared-operations prompt includes full candidate code, not supplemental caller files. Jev uses bounded context; source worker/coordinator inspect callers separately.

source_adjudication.resolution: Both reviewers separate; direct owner/caller linkage resolves overlap.
